links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT responses when asked for specific literature references
links.effect: The chatbot frequently generated inaccurate responses when asked for specific literature references. Overall, 52 of 95 (55%) responses were completely accurate by both raters.
links.quote: Notably, the chatbot frequently generated inaccurate responses when asked for specific literature references and when the input prompt contained deliberate errors (biased prompts).
